gen-gf-offside-gf-geom: Expressive and commanding, Offside leaves its curves open and tracks its letters wide, every stroke held to one thickness. Geom, a plain sans with lofty lowercase, then takes the quieter lead.
gen-gf-offside-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Bent-wire curves, wide spacing, a quiet level beat: that's Offside. Offside is the one that announces itself, while Kdam Thmor Pro, a sans-serif, lets its bowls fill the line and handles the talking.
gen-gf-offside-gf-krona-one: Open curves, constant strokes: Offside in a nutshell. Krona One, a sans with the stature of cast iron capitals, lands loose and weighty beside it, a sturdy foil to that hushed heading.
gen-gf-offside-gf-menbere: Menbere's sans lowercase stacks tall and tidy, like rolled cord, and reads cleanly. And Offside, with stems and crossbars sharing one thickness, sets a wide, level, commanding tone on top.
gen-gf-offside-gf-momo-trust-display: Round letters drawn like bent wire give Offside its look, spaced wide and left open. Momo Trust Display, a sans-serif with a generous x-height, drifts along comfortably, its letters spaced far apart.
gen-gf-offside-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar, a sans-serif with compressed ascender length, keeps text compact and approachable beneath Offside, whose stencil-cut letters hold one width. Paragraphs move along briskly, at a friendly, unhurried pace.
gen-gf-offside-gf-narnoor: Narnoor, a plain sans with short ascenders above big bowls, sits under Offside, whose line weight hums flat and constant. Text goes down smoothly, with a measured, workmanlike rhythm.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display fills every word with a big, tall middle zone. Under Offside, with its technical-pen steadiness, that plain sans keeps text generous and approachable, line after line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed makes ordinary text look magnified, with a steady weight. What stands out most is how the plain sans keeps level with Offside, both holding a quiet, unvarying beat.
gen-gf-offside-gf-secular-one: Wide-set, open-curved and quietly commanding, that's Offside all over. Secular One, a sans with a dominant midsection and zero modulation, reads in dense, uniform blocks that carry text with a steady hand.
